title: 耳孔鸭舌帽
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve character equipment design. Fresh clean rendering of a production reference sheet, no overlays. Reference1 is canonical Cocoa kitten identity; reference2 is approved left-side crescent satchel unchanged; reference3 is a FAILED OVER-DEEP HAT, use only its fabric palette and sheet arrangement, NOT its crown depth.
Create a square warm ivory photoreal design sheet, 3 columns BASE / READY / ITEM, four rows FRONT / LEFT / BACK / RIGHT. Eight full body kittens total with real four-paw stance. BASE wears original yellow bib and approved crescent shoulder satchel. READY wears the identical outfit plus a NORMAL SHALLOW BASEBALL CAP WITH EAR HOLES. ITEM shows only cap in four corresponding views. A small top view detail shows two ear holes.
Crucial cap correction: a properly head-sized everyday low-profile duckbill/baseball cap, NOT a bonnet, hood, helmet or swim cap. Low shallow crown covers only top one-third of skull. A projecting curved cocoa visor over forehead, cream twill crown. TWO ear cutouts at front-left and front-right crown, ears protrude through stitched rims. Cap is full head WIDTH but only SHALLOW in HEIGHT. Rear cap edge sits HIGH across the TOP BACK of skull near ear-base level, NOT at nape. Entire lower two-thirds of back-of-head stays exposed brown fur. From BACK show a shallow crescent of cream fabric at top, an ordinary baseball-cap semicircular REAR ADJUSTMENT OPENING revealing brown fur, and a narrow short adjustment strap at upper skull. Plenty of uninterrupted exposed brown fur between cap and neck/bib. NO elastic gathered bonnet edge, no fabric descending behind ears to neck, no side flaps. Side views must show open exposed lower occiput and neck. Crown overall shallower than reference3 by about two-thirds. Preserve cream fabric, brown paw embroidery, cocoa visor with tiny teal underside, no new ornaments.
Kitten: chocolate/white fluffy fur, milky white eyebrow spots, large teal-green eyes, pink nose, yellow triangular paw bib, cream-tipped question tail; same face as reference1. All EIGHT kittens have one LEVEL horizontal warm-white self-luminous angel halo floating visibly above ears/cap with airgap. No metal, cup, wings. Bag physically stays anatomical LEFT, naturally invisible from RIGHT view; don't move it for camera. Hat never alone as work outfit. Match same shallow crown in both worn and standalone views. Clear natural fur, stable anatomy, no grids on rendering textures. Headers "SHALLOW EAR-HOLE CAP", BASE, READY, ITEM and row labels only.
correctionPrompt: Regenerate this SAME sheet cleanly, preserve the shallow baseball cap shape, exposed lower back-of-head, TWO ear ports, all cat identity/poses/bags, column layout and text. Make ONLY TWO technical fixes: (1) every kitten MUST have one level horizontal luminous warm-white angel halo above head. There are 8 cats. BASE 4 already have halos. READY middle-column FRONT top row currently missing and RIGHT bottom row missing: restore these 2 halos. Total EIGHT halos, one per cat, including above all hats with air gap, no ornaments or metal. (2) ITEM column BACK row currently has brown fur inside the rear adjustment opening: REMOVE all fur/cat material from standalone hat; its rear opening is EMPTY see-through warm ivory background. No cat fragment in any standalone object. Same existing cap design, same width and shallow height, lower occiput exposed. No other changes. Exact same left-side bag physical occlusion.

title: 工具卷包
prompt:
Create a clean photoreal production design sheet for the SAME Cocoa kitten and departure equipment. Real detailed fur and fabric, warm ivory studio background, square 1536x1536 requested, clear THREE VERTICAL COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS. Column headers BASE / READY / ITEM. Rows FRONT / LEFT / BACK / RIGHT: matching full-body front, nose-left profile, true rear, nose-right profile. BASE=kitten without the new item; READY=same kitten with the new item; ITEM=the new object alone in matching four views. Exactly one cat per character cell; ordinary FOUR-PAW stance, no human limbs. The three columns and four rows must be clear.
Character identity from reference: chocolate-and-white fluffy kitten, vivid milky-white eyebrow spots, round teal-green eyes, pink nose, normal ears, yellow triangular paw-print bib, cream-tipped thick question-mark tail. Preserve this exact face and body. Every cat has ONE simple LEVEL horizontal warm-white luminous angel halo, no metal ring, ornaments or cup; all WINGLESS. Halo independent of hat. Original bib visible. No cape unless expressly requested (none here). No magical powers or new characters. Same physical object location through all rotations, no body intersections. Objects scaled to small kitten. Regenerate the whole board cleanly, no overlays. Minimal English labels only. Object FRONT refers to item's front, BACK shows harness/construction; sides expose depth. No irrelevant props.
SPECIFIC DESIGN AND REQUIRED CORRECTIONS:
A compact rolled TOOL ORGANIZER, clearly not bedding and not food. Matte sage-teal waxed canvas outer shell, flat cream piping, two cocoa straps with small simple buckles, a cream stitched paw-shaped pull tab. NO fleece, plush pile, thick quilt, blanket, cinnamon spiral, pastry, sleeping mat. Rolled ends show several THIN layers of canvas plus tucked tool-slot flap, closed with flat END FLAPS, not spiraling fleece. Carried horizontally on UPPER thoracic back behind neck/shoulder blades, ahead of hips, no obstruction to tail; same small scale and high placement across views. Front edge below nape, bag bottom fully above tail root on rear view. Narrow low-profile harness routed away from original yellow bib. ITEM column shows CLOSED tool roll front/left/back/right. CRUCIAL add a distinct BOTTOM DETAIL STRIP beneath four rows labeled "UNROLLED TOOL POCKETS": SAME canvas roll unfolded flat reveals 4 narrow sewn tool sleeves, containing tiny ruler, short soft brush, blunt rounded wooden wedge and coiled cotton cord. Practical kitten-sized maintenance/helper tools, no sharp blades. Thin fabric interior with reinforced stitching and securing straps establishes TOOLS, not a bedding roll. Title "CANVAS TOOL ROLL".
